_: Drop these into Retell as Custom Functions. Set the URL to https://buypremier.com/api/voice/<name> (or your *.workers.dev). Add a header `Authorization: Bearer <RETELL_WEBHOOK_SECRET>` matching the Worker secret.

functions.name: lookup_machine
functions.description: Search Premier's live inventory for machines matching the caller's request (tonnage, brand, model). ALWAYS call this before saying anything specific about a machine.

query.description: Free-text caller request, e.g. '300 ton hydraulic', 'Milacron 500', 'all-electric under 250'.

functions.returns_description: Returns up to 3 matching machines from Premier's inventory.json. Quote ONLY these. If found=0, use the fallback_message and offer a callback.

functions.name: book_call
functions.description: Schedule a callback from Nicole. Call this once you have a name and phone. ALWAYS call this before ending the call (unless caller refuses).

phone.description: Best phone number, digits only or formatted

topic.description: Short summary of what they want to discuss

when_iso.description: Requested time as free text (e.g. 'tomorrow morning', 'today after 3pm', 'asap')

functions.returns_description: Returns a confirmation sentence to read back to the caller.

functions.name: create_lead
functions.description: Log a lead in Premier's CRM. Use for sellers (always) and for buyers who want something not currently in stock.

type.description: 'seller' if they have a machine to sell; 'buyer' otherwise

machine.description: Free-text description of the machine of interest

note.description: Anything else the caller said that Nicole should know

functions.returns_description: Just confirms the lead was stored.

functions.name: post_call
functions.description: Internal: Retell's post-call webhook. Configure this URL in the Retell agent's 'Post-Call Webhook' setting (not as a regular tool the agent invokes).
functions.returns_description: Stores the call transcript and summary in Premier's call_records table.
